name: 336 Marketplace
summary: 336 Marketplace is an 88-acre community shopping center located at the highly visible intersection of Loop 336 and Interstate 45 North in Conroe, Texas. Featuring numerous national retailers and service providers, this open-air center serves the rapidly growing Montgomery County market with convenient access and ample parking.
demographics: 336 Marketplace serves the rapidly growing Conroe, Texas market, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $100,000+. The primary trade area draws from Montgomery County's diverse population, including young families, professionals commuting to Houston, and established residents seeking convenient shopping options. The center benefits from Conroe's position as one of the fastest-growing cities in Texas, with shoppers typically ranging from 25-65 years old who value a mix of national retailers, dining options, and service-oriented businesses in an accessible open-air format.
description: 336 Marketplace is an expansive 88-acre community shopping center strategically positioned at the southwest corner of Loop 336 and Interstate 45 North in Conroe, Texas. This prominent retail destination serves the thriving Montgomery County market with numerous national retailers and service providers in a convenient open-air format. The center's exceptional visibility and accessibility from I-45, one of the major corridors connecting Houston to North Texas, makes it a natural stopping point for both local residents and travelers. Developed and managed by Federal Realty Investment Trust (FRPLT), 336 Marketplace offers a diverse tenant mix that caters to the everyday needs of Conroe's rapidly expanding population. The property's substantial acreage allows for ample parking and a comfortable shopping experience, while its location in one of Texas's fastest-growing metropolitan areas positions it as a key retail hub for the region.
